prompt: Explain `jms sftp`'s automatic direction detection and give the direction plus the equivalent library API call (function name and key arguments) for each of: 1) jms sftp ./data.tar.gz web@prod:/tmp/  2) jms sftp web@prod:/tmp/data.tar.gz ./  3) jms sftp a@s1:/f b@s2:/g. Verify example 3 with skills/jms-transfer/scripts/check_sftp_spec.py and record the actual output. Save the explanation and output as direction.md in the output directory.
assertions: direction.md explains the direction rule (colon marks a remote side)
call 1 is upload, equivalent library call sftp_transfer
call 2 is download, equivalent library call sftp_transfer (is_upload=False)
call 3 is relay, equivalent library call relay_transfer + RelaySpec
records the actual check_sftp_spec.py output for 'a@s1:/f b@s2:/g' (relay: ...)
